_comment: Английские подписи флагов для «Я» → «Что со мной было» (scenes/_memos.json). Только переведённые жизни; остальное — по-русски до перевода.

F_Т01.СПОР: At seven I raced Vitka to the snag. I didn't make it.
F_Т01.БУБЛИК: At seven I jumped into the backwater after Bublik. Bublik made it out.
F_Т01.ЧАСЫ: At seven I dove for the glint by the snag and came up with a watch in my fist. It's stopped at 4:12.
F_Т01.ДОЛГ: At seven I ran for the grown-ups, and Vitka stayed in the water. I owe him.

F_Т02.ЧЕЙ: Under the water somebody asked me, "Whose kid are you?"
F_Т02.ХОР: Under the water somebody was counting along with the girl. Lots of voices.
F_Т02.ЛИЦО: Under the water I looked down and saw myself on the sand, with an old man over me.
F_Т02.МАМА: Under the water I called for Mom, and a stranger's palm lay on my forehead.

F_Т03.ШРАМ: Punched Shmelyov for calling me Vodyanoy, and whatever happened, happened.
F_Т03.ВОДЯНОЙ: Made the nickname Vodyanoy my own.
F_Т03.ЗАМЕТКА: Put up notices, and the Kuzbass paper wrote about it: looking for the old man in the striped shirt.
F_Т03.ВОДОБОЯЗНЬ: Swore never to talk about water again.

F_Т04.РЕЛЬСЫ: Sat on the railroad tracks with Dad in ninety-eight.
F_Т04.РЫНОК: Sold frying pans at the market with Mom.
F_Т04.ЦВЕТМЕТ: Cut cable for scrap copper with Vitka.
F_Т04.ОЛИМПИАДА: Went to the math olympiad with Nina Petrovna.

F_Т05.ТЕТРАДИ: Read Granddad's notebooks. I remember a sentence in the margin.
F_Т05.ФОТО: I know who the second man in Granddad's photo is.
F_Т05.ПРОДАЛ: Sold Granddad's box to the junk dealer for Sega cartridges.
F_Т05.СОЖЖЕНО: Gave Granddad's box to Dad. Dad burned it.

F_Т06.ПЕРЕПЛЫЛ: Swam across Black Backwater with Nika.
F_Т06.ТАЙНА_НИКИ: Told Nika about the dark under the water. Nobody else.
F_Т06.ПАЦАНЫ: Laughed at "the Novosibirsk girl" with the guys.
F_Т06.БАКЕНЩИК: The buoy keeper told me about a man who stands by the backwater every July.

F_Т07.КЛЮЧИ: Yanked the keys out of Vitka's Lada Nine on the ice.
F_Т07.ЛЁД: Drove across the frozen Tom. My body remembers what to do.
F_Т07.СДАЛ: Called Dad from a pay phone so Vitka wouldn't drive on the ice.
F_Т07.ВИДЕНИЕ: Saw Vitka go under the ice. In this world he didn't.

F_Т08.ПАЛЫЧ: Hauled air tanks for the mine rescuers for three nights while Dad was underground.
F_Т08.ДОМ: Held it together at home for three nights, for Mom and Sonka.
F_Т08.ТОРГ: Went to the backwater for three nights and bargained with the water for Dad.
F_Т08.ДАТЧИКИ: Found out why the Glubokaya blew and told a reporter.

F_Т09.АРМИЯ: Gave Vitka a proper send-off to the army.
F_Т09.ДОЛГ_СВАРНОМУ: Helped Vitka dodge the draft through Welder. Now I owe Welder.
F_Т09.НИКА: Went to the dacha with Nika instead of Vitka's send-off.
F_Т09.ДВЕРЬ: In the garage Dad said, "Under the mine. There was a door down there."

F_ЗНАЕТ: I've already died once. I remember it like a memory.
F_ЗНАЕТ_ДЕДА: I know who my grandfather was.

F_ЖЕНА.ЖИВА: Noticed my wife was tired, and got there in time.
F_ЖЕНА.УМЕРЛА: My wife has been gone since '47.

F_ПАРТНЁР.ТАНЯ: Tanya is beside me. She doesn't hand me a lamp anymore; she hides it.
F_ПАРТНЁР.ПЛОЙ: Ploy is beside me. Under the water she holds my hand.
F_ПАРТНЁР.ЛЕРА: Lera is beside me. Her scar is on her arm, and I remember which one.
F_ПАРТНЁР.САРДААНА: Sardaana is beside me. She measures mammoths with her mother's flowery tape measure.

F_РАЗВЕДЧИК: I died three times on Varya's highway in a single morning and talked her down it minute by minute.
F_ОДЕЯЛО: Went into the burning kids' room under a wet blanket.

F_В701.НИКА: Answered Nika with a long letter.
F_В701.ОЛЯ: Went to the movies with Olya from the next stairwell.

F_В703.ВАРЯ: Got Varya to the pharmacy alive. In another world I didn't.

F_В704.ТЕСТЬ: Dragged my father-in-law out of the banya into the snow.
F_В704.ПОМНИЛ: Dragged my father-in-law out of the banya because I remembered how people fall asleep in there. The next morning he had a different father.
F_В704.УМЕР: Walked out of the banya alone. My father-in-law stayed on the bench, and there was no going back for him.

F_В705.ВИШНЯ: Let the oncoming KAMAZ by. The silver Granta turned cherry red.
F_В705.ПЕРВЫЙ: Passed the semi right behind the KAMAZ, because I remembered it.
F_В705.ВТОРОЙ: Passed the semi only after the second KAMAZ, the one that wasn't there the first time.

F_В706.ДВЕРЬ: Pulled Varya out of the burning kids' room.
F_В706.ЗНАНИЕ: Went back to eight in the evening and didn't plug in the lights. Varya has written with her left hand ever since.

F_В708.СПАС: Pulled Kolka out from under the ice.
F_В708.ПОМНИЛ: Ran around Kolka along the bank, because I remembered where the ice was thin. Now Kolka's scar is on the other knee.

F_В709.ПРАВДА: Told my wife about the icicle, the lights and the pond.
F_В709.РАЗВЕДКА: I died on Varya's road so I'd know what was waiting for her.
